summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Next Day Disclosure Return (Form 6-K) for the Hong Kong Exchange reporting a series of open-market share repurchases from March 20 to April 15, 2026. Approximately 13.14 million shares were bought for cancellation at prices ranging from USD 6.5654 to 7.1427 per share, representing roughly 1.56% of shares outstanding. The buybacks are authorized by the board as part of a capital return program. The shares remain listed and traded on HKEX (ticker 02076). The filing is a routine disclosure of capital return activity with no premium, tender, or change of control. What to watch: continued repurchase pace and potential cancellation timeline.
